epics.title: Runtime Environment Initialization Repair
epics.jtbd: When the end customer attempts to launch the application, I want the system to start successfully without network conflicts, so that the product is actually available for use.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: DPMO on application startup failures due to container naming conflicts
requirements: R1: Dynamic container naming to prevent conflicts during launch

slices.title: Remove hardcoded container names from Docker Compose
slices.jtbd: When implementing dynamic container naming for this epic, I want to remove hardcoded container_name declarations, so that the container starts without name conflicts.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean Docker environment
When docker compose up is executed concurrently or repeatedly
Then it must not fail with a container name conflict
Given the docker-compose.yml and docker-compose.override.yml files
When inspected
Then they must not contain hardcoded container_name fields
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero duplicate container name conflict errors
